What worked for be wasnt going cold-turkey. First I maintain two browsers, one for the addictive crap like youtube, social media etc so there's a clear seperation. Then I also avoid logging into accounts and also blocking cookies for those sites. Youtube in particular is bad for this, endlessly recommending content based on 1 video view. Now I just need to hit refresh once and their homepage becomes empty and has nothing to recommend.

Managed to kick tiktok, facebook and insta out my life this way. All that's left are youtube and reddit which I'll still use but at highly reduced rates.
